notes.title: NEW UPDATE MARCH 2022
notes.notes:
Hello!
We are excited to announce our new update on 2030!

Several bug fixed:

- Jeep on the moon surface its no more, we are dealing with some issues, he will be back soon...

- Crosshair its fixed! now looks better

- Better performance on FPS

- NEW!: Now you can watch the bullets of your weapon with a nice FX (apply for rifles)

- some graphics tweeks

- Zombies are faster and smarter // new characters on the 3rd map!

- Sound problems fixed

/// 

NEXT UPDATE soon it will include

- NEW MAPS
- NEW CHARACTERS
- SOUND SETTINGS WORKING (we are working on that on the next update)


Hope you enjoy our last release! remember: its more fun to play with friends! Host a game and call your friends via STEAM to play it with at least 4 characters on map


THANKS FOR PLAYING OUR INDIE GAMES

notes.title: Thanks to play 2030!
notes.notes:
Hello!
Thank you for play "2030"!

Just passing by to thank you for getting this indie release!
Want to let you guys know that we are going to make updates for this game in not distant future

Some bugs has been found like the Jeep on the moon surface and we noticed that the smoke of the fire could be a problem for low spec machines so we are going to make a version without it for all to be playing.

Its important to us to stay in touch with our buyers so let me know if you have some thoughts for the next updates

As indie devs, we do a lot of work to make people having fun and a good time without taking the gamming so seriously, we love to have fun! hope you feel the spirit of our studio and enjoy our games

Thanks again and see you on the community hub!


Leandro
LFR Games
